CONFIDENTIAL.
August 24, 25.

My dear Barton,

With reference to your request
for particulars as to the activities of the
Russian Labour Delegation which recently came
to Shanghai, the following information has been
obtained by the Police :-

"The members of the Delegation of represent-
atives of the all Russian Council of Labour
Unions, which is at present visiting China,
arrived in Shanghai on July 30 and have since
then been staying in the Soviet Consulate. The
party comprises: Mr. Lepse, representative of
the Labour Union of Metal workers who is a
member of the Presidium of All-Russia Central
Council of Trade-Unions of Moscow. Mr. Smulgin
or Smoorgis, a member of the Board of Committees
who is also a member of All-Russia Central
Council of Trade-Unions. Mr. Briskin of Habarovsk,
representative of the Far Eastern Bureau of the
All-Russia Central Council of Labour Unions. Mr.
Vladimir Vaskoff or Vaskin, correspondent of the
Newspaper "Trud" (Labour) and Mrs. Zenaide Richter,
a special correspondent for the "Izvestia." Upon
arrival here they were met at the Railway Station
by Messrs. Vilde and Hassis, two officials of the
Soviet Consulate and several other Russians, but
no Chinese were present.

亲爱的巴顿：

关于你要求提供最近抵达上海的俄罗斯劳工代表团活动详情的请求，警方已获取如下信息：

“全俄工会理事会代表代表团成员目前正在中国访问，他们于7月30日抵达上海，此后一直居住在苏联领事馆。该团成员包括：勒普塞先生（Mr. Lepse），金属工人工会代表，莫斯科全俄中央工会理事会主席团成员；斯穆尔金或斯莫尔吉斯先生（Mr. Smulgin or Smoorgis），委员会成员，也是全俄中央工会理事会成员；来自哈巴罗夫斯克的布里斯金先生（Mr. Briskin），全俄中央工会理事会远东局代表；弗拉基米尔·瓦斯科夫或瓦斯金先生（Mr. Vladimir Vaskoff or Vaskin），《劳动报》（Trud）记者；以及泽奈德·里希特夫人（Mrs. Zenaide Richter），《消息报》（Izvestia）特约记者。抵达此处时，他们在火车站受到苏联领事馆两名官员维尔德和哈西斯先生以及其他几名俄罗斯人的迎接，但没有中国人在场。”

Activities of the members of the Delegation
during their sojourn here include a call upon the
Commissioner of Foreign Affairs, visits to Chinese
Labour Organizations and some press propaganda. It
is noteworthy that, notwithstanding the hostility
of the Labour Unions to foreigners in general, the
leaders of these bodies gave a most cordial
reception to the Soviet agents.

After calling in the morning on the Commissioner
of Foreign Affairs, they visited the Shanghai General
Labour Union on the afternoon of August 1. There they
were met by the leaders of the organization, who
through an interpreter, gave an account of the events
leading up to the strike and the part played by the
Union in the conduct of the campaign. They also
explained the system of organization followed in the
forming of the Chinese Labour Unions. The "Red"
leaders appeared to be very pleased with the story
and congratulated their hosts on the success that had
been achieved.

Three of the Delegation at 4 p.m. on August 4,
visited a branch of the Shanghai General Labour
Union in Ying Tsiang Hong. This organization is
situated on the borders of the industrial district
known as Yangtzepoo and since the general strike
began has been used as a base for the furthering of
agitation and the distribution of strike pay. Most of
the employees of the Japanese Cotton Mills and other
foreign factories in the Yangtzepoo district are
either members of this organization or in some way
connected with it. When the Russian delegates arrived

2.

代表团成员在此逗留期间的活动包括拜访外交专员、访问中国劳工组织以及一些新闻宣传。值得注意的是，尽管工会总体上对外国人持敌对态度，但这些组织的领导人对苏联代理人给予了最热烈的接待。

在上午拜访外交专员后，他们于8月1日下午访问了上海总工会。在那里，他们受到了该组织领导人的接见，领导人通过翻译讲述了导致罢工的事件经过，以及工会在运动开展过程中所发挥的作用。他们还解释了中国工会组建时所遵循的组织体系。“红色”领导人似乎对这些叙述感到非常满意，并祝贺东道主取得的成就。

8月4日下午4时，代表团中的三人访问了位于引翔港的上海总工会分会。该组织位于被称为杨树浦的工业区边缘，自总罢工开始以来，一直被用作推进煽动活动和分发罢工津贴的基地。杨树浦地区日本棉纺厂和其他外国工厂的大部分雇员要么是该组织的成员，要么以某种方式与其有关联。当俄罗斯代表抵达

there they were met by Liu Kwei Tsz (          )
and Koh Kee Zung who gave them a copy of the
Union regulations. After a conversation lasting
about an hour, the visit came to an end. The
Russians here again repeatedly expressed their
admiration for the organizing ability and unity
manifested by the Chinese workers.

The members of the Delegation on the morning
of August 6 went to the General Union of Labour,
Commerce and Education near the West Gate, where
the cordial reception encountered elsewhere was
repeated. They had a conversation lasting the
better part of an hour with Li Lih San (          )
and then left. Li Lih San a returned student from
France is a notorious communist. He is probably
the most influential of all the labour leaders
connected with the present movement. He claims to
have 150,000 followers in Shanghai. These, it is
alleged, include the bulk of local members of the
original organizations known as the Red Guild and
the Green Guild.

At 3.30 p.m. on August 7 four members of the
Soviet Delegation visited the Shanghai Students
Union at 8 Poh An Fong, Boon Laid Road, inside the
small West Gate. They chatted for about an hour
with the Chairman of the Union named Zoo Koh Nee
(          ) and his lieutenant Lieu Yih Tsing
(          ). The leaders gave the Russian visitors
their version of the shooting in Nanking Road and
expressed their determination to continue the
struggle until their demands are granted.

那里时，他们受到了刘贵兹（Liu Kwei Tsz，音译）和郭其宗（Koh Kee Zung，音译）的接待，后者向他们提供了一份工会章程副本。经过约一小时的交谈后，访问结束。俄罗斯人再次反复表达了对中国工人所表现出的组织能力和团结精神的钦佩。

8月6日上午，代表团成员前往小西门附近的工商学联合总会，在那里受到了与其他地方相同的热烈接待。他们与李立三（Li Lih San，音译）进行了大半个小时的谈话，随后离开。李立三是一名留法归国学生，是一名臭名昭著的共产党人。他可能是与当前运动有关的所有劳工领袖中最具影响力的一位。他声称在上海拥有15万名追随者。据称，这些人包括原称为红帮和青帮的地方成员的大多数。

8月7日下午3时30分，苏联代表团的四名成员访问了位于小西门内邦莱路保安坊8号的上海学生联合会。他们与该会主席朱科尼（Zoo Koh Nee，音译）及其副手刘一清（Lieu Yih Tsing，音译）交谈了约一小时。领导人们向俄罗斯访客陈述了他们对南京路枪击事件的版本，并表示决心继续斗争，直到他们的要求得到满足。

A second visit was made by the members of the
Delegation to the offices of the Shanghai Students
Union inside the small West Gate, at 2.15 p.m.
August 11. Further conversations took place then,
about the boycott and strike and Hoo Hoh Hee is
reported to have suggested that any monetary aid
from sympathizers in Soviet Russia would be grate-
fully received.

The China Press of August 6 contains an account
of an interview between Miss Louise Wilson, lady
reporter of that newspaper, and Mrs. Zenaide Richter.
With the aid of an interpreter the latter talked
about the benefits which the revolution had brought
the women of Russia in the social, economic and
political spheres. The same paper in its issue of
August 16 published a picture of the four male-
members of the delegation. A picture of the same
party in a group with some Chinese friends appeared
in the Sunday Pictorial issue of the Eastern Times,
a Chinese newspaper on August 16. One of the Chinese
is Hoo Hok Hee, Chairman of the Students Union.

The members of the Delegation on August 3
stated that they intended to leave for Canton a
week later. Nevertheless they are still here, but
will probably go away soon. They seem to take a
great interest in the activities of the Soviet
Consulate and spend a good deal of their time in
conferences with the officials of that establishment.

Yours sincerely,

J. Barton Esq.,
H. B. McConnel General,
Shanghai.

THE CANTON GAZETTE. MONDAY, AUGUST 31 1925.

MAYOR'S ADDRESS
"My beloved Russian Comrades, You all have come a long distance from Russia to Canton. While our National Revolution is in progress, I am so glad to have so rare an opportunity to say a few words to my advanced revolutionary comrades. Before my speech, I would like, on behalf of the Nationalist Government and all the people of Canton, to offer our heartiest welcome to you, Russian Comrades. Dr. Sun Yat sen, the father of our Republic, and Lenin, father of the Soviet Republic, had been working for the Revolution in their respective lands for many years. The policy followed by Dr. Sun Yat-sen and that of Lenin, though different in method yet their aims--the freedom and independence of the workers were the same. Both Dr. Sun Yat-sen and Lenin because of their mutual views were friends although they had never seen each other or spoken to each other. Because of this, the friendship between China and Russia at present now exists and grows stronger day by day. Dr. Sun Yat-sen is dead but his spirit and his principles still remain. Our revolutionary strength has increased day by day. Though complete victory is far from us, yet we are bearing the same responsibility with you all, for both China and Russia are now working in the same revolutionary path. You all are Revolutionary Soldiers who have come to visit our capital, the national revolutionary center of China. The success of our Chinese National Revolution, we hope will soon be achieved.

市长演说

“亲爱的俄国同志们，你们不远万里从俄国来到广州。值此我国国民革命进行之际，我很高兴能有此难得机会，向各位先进的革命同志说几句话。在开始演讲之前，我谨代表国民政府及广州全体人民，向各位俄国同志表示最热烈的欢迎。我国共和之父孙中山博士，与苏维埃共和国之父列宁，多年来分别在各自的国家为革命事业奋斗。孙博士与列宁所奉行的政策，虽然方法不同，但其目标——即工人的自由与独立——则是相同的。孙博士与列宁因彼此观点一致而成为朋友，尽管他们从未谋面或交谈。正因如此，目前中俄之间的友谊得以存在并日益加强。孙博士虽已逝世，但其精神与原则犹存。我们的革命力量日益增强。虽然完全胜利尚需时日，但我们与诸位肩负着同样的责任，因为中俄两国正走在同一条革命道路上。诸位是前来访问我国首都、中国国民革命中心的革命战士。我们希望中国国民革命的成功不久即可实现。

“列宁”号船员的同志们，自从沙基惨案发生以来，广州的航运完全被帝国主义者封锁，他们企图利用饥饿这一武器置我们于死地。我们为了实现广东的经济独立计划，必须征调更多船只来供应广州的粮食。你们前来帮助我们实现经济独立。你们给广州人民带来了厚礼，我们将永志不忘。中国与苏维埃俄国地理上相距遥远，一在北，一在南，然而我们的同志能够在中国革命的中心广州相聚，并握手致意。从今以后，我们将加强彼此合作，以对抗我们的敌人——帝国主义者。这就是今晚我们举行欢迎会的真正意义。”
